India to host five-time world champion Brazil in Kolkata friendly

The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has announced that the Indian national football team will play a friendly match against five-time world champions Brazil. The match is scheduled to take place on October 3, 2026, in Kolkata. This event is being highlighted as a significant moment for Indian football history.
